RMKS/
1. REMARKS: THIS CANCELS REF A (WTXS21 PGTW 171800). THE AREA OF 
CONVECTION (INVEST 96S) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 5.6S 90.2E IS NOW 
LOCATED NEAR 5.6S 90.2E, APPROXIMATELY 566 NM NORTHWEST OF COCOS 
ISLANDS. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED(EIR) SATELLITE DEPICTS A FULLY 
EXPOSED LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC), POSITIOEND TO THE NORTH OF 
A AN AREA OF PERSISTENT DEEP CONVECTION, SHEARED TO THE SOUTH DUE TO 
PERSISTENT, MODERATE NORTHEASTERLY VERTICAL WIND SHEAR. ENVIRONMENTAL 
ANALYSIS REVEALS A MARGINAL ENVIRONMENT FOR DEVELOPMENT WITH A HIGH 
VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (VWS) OF (30 TO 35 KNOTS), MODERATE TO STRONG 
POLEWARD UPPER-LEVEL OUTFLOW, AND WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (SSTS) 
OF (28 TO 29 C). GLOBAL DETERMINISTIC MODELS DEPICT A CLEARLY DEFINED 
CIRCUCLATION HOWEVER, THE SYSTEM STRUGGLES TO MEET WIND SPEED CRITERIA 
AS IT TRAVERSES SOUTHWARD. ENSEMBLE MODELS DEPICT A STEADY-STATE 
INTENSITY TREND OVER THE NEXT 24-36 HOURS DOWNGRADED TO MEDIUM.//
